sector_gap_method.summary: Operator-independent sector test prepared: Tr[P_k P_q e^{-beta H}] per HS configuration via Gaussian-unitary insertion (c_U = det(1 + u)/2^n) and exact Pfaffian composition; eigenvalue -1 via the exact eta split placed cyclically; brute force 1e-13 for general unitaries, Z4 and translation projectors. Physics run pending (zero twist only; Gamma modes deconvolved; cost N_cell x 4 compositions per configuration). Active Z4 charge Z_a = e^{i pi (N - N_Gamma)/2} inserted directly (brute force 2e-15); post-hoc deconvolution of total-charge sectors is impossible (Gamma character (1 + i^m)^32 vanishes at m = 2, rank 3) -> killed. SG5 (beta plateau, exactly solvable free limit on 16 sites, active charge, 60 digits with exact roots of unity): slope estimator 8 -> 16 gives 2.8286 vs exact 2.8284 (enumerated, with free P zero-mode shifts), the naive estimator at beta = 16 is 0.45 too low (log degeneracy / beta). Lessons: (i) the slope method works; (ii) symmetry phases must be exact roots of unity (float phases destroy the cancellation below e^{-beta Delta} ~ 1e-14); (iii) in QMC the signal-to-noise of a sector trace falls like e^{-beta Delta}, so only moderate beta Delta is accessible. A full Fock reference for the interacting Theta_1 on 4 sites is impossible (128 modes); exact references are the free limit and small interacting toy models.

symmetric_transfer.summary: The HS slice of reweight.py is one exponential of the full bilinear sum_x phi_x . The slice differs from e^{-dtau H} by 6 % at dtau = 0.25: dtau extrapolation remains mandatory for gap values.

sector_integrator_symmetry.statement: The transfer matrix that the QMC actually simulates is T = W_h E_phi[e^{K(phi)}] W_h (the HS average of one slice; slices are independent Gaussian, so E[prod_l X_l] = T^L and every sector trace Tr[P T^L] is an exact expectation of the per-configuration traces). This T commutes with P_k and with the active-charge projector P_q^a exactly (solvable ring: [T, translation] 1e-15, [T, Z4] 1e-17). The per-configuration slice e^{K(phi)} does NOT commute with them -- it does not need to; the ordered-gate leak mechanism (counter-check 1.5e-2) does not apply. No group-averaged integrator is required. ST4 (production code, frozen Theta_1, g = 0.1): cell translations commute with W_h, K(phi) is translation covariant (residual 2.5e-16) and Z4 maps K(phi) to K(-phi); release tied to integrator hash f0f2d58fada5669b.
